summaries.name: Hahnel Captur Remote Control
summaries.summary: Hahnel Captur Remote Control is a wireless remote shutter release using radio frequency (RF) technology to trigger the shutter. It is compact, lightweight, and compatible with many Nikon cameras.

summaries.name: Vello RS-N2II Wired Remote Shutter Release
summaries.summary: Vello RS-N2II is a wired remote shutter release compatible with Nikon cameras. It is simple and affordable, allowing the shutter to be triggered from a distance.

summaries.name: B+W 10-Stop Neutral Density Filter
summaries.summary: B+W 10-Stop Neutral Density Filter is a popular 10-stop ND filter from the well-respected B+W brand, available in sizes including 52mm, 58mm, 62mm, 67mm, and 72mm.

summaries.name: Hoya PRO1 Digital Circular Polarizer and Neutral Density Filter
summaries.summary: Hoya PRO1 Digital Circular Polarizer and Neutral Density Filter is a high-quality 10-stop ND filter from Hoya that also includes a circular polarizer, which helps reduce glare and enhance colors.

summaries.name: Tiffen 10-Stop Neutral Density Filter
summaries.summary: Tiffen 10-Stop Neutral Density Filter is a 10-stop ND filter from the reputable Tiffen brand, known for high-quality glass and durable construction.

summaries.name: NiSi 10-Stop Neutral Density Filter
summaries.summary: NiSi 10-Stop Neutral Density Filter is a 10-stop ND filter from newer brand NiSi, known for high-quality glass and an affordable price point.

summaries.name: Singh-Ray 10-Stop Neutral Density Filter
summaries.summary: Singh-Ray 10-Stop Neutral Density Filter is a high-end 10-stop ND filter from Singh-Ray, known for exceptional quality and popular among professional photographers.
